high_descs: Turn around and stand by the desk.
Pick up the baseball bat to the right of the desk.
Walk to the left side of the desk
Turn on the lamp.
anns.task_desc: Examine the baseball bat using the lamp light.

high_descs: Turn completely around and walk over to the desk.
Pick up the baseball bat that is on the floor to the right of the desk.
Move to the other side of the desk where the lamp is sitting.
Turn on the lamp.
anns.task_desc: Inspect a baseball bat using the light of a lamp.

high_descs: Move to the desk to the left of the mirror
pick up a bat from the floor
move to the lamp to the left of you
turn on the lamp
anns.task_desc: Inspect a bat with a lamp.

high_descs: Turn around and walk to the baseball bat leaning against the wall to the right of the desk.
Pick up the baseball bat, handle end up.
Turn and carry the bat to the left side of the desk.
Turn on the lamp located at the left rear of the desk top.
anns.task_desc: Pick up a baseball bat, turn on a lamp on the desk

high_descs: Turn right and step toward the door, then turn left and walk to the desk.
Pick up the baseball bat that is laying against the wall to the right of the desk.
Turn left and walk toward the bed, then turn right to face the desk.
Turn on the lamp that is on the desk.
anns.task_desc: Turn on the desk lamp while holding the baseball bat.

high_descs: Turn and ,move to stand at the right edge of the desk, which is closest to the wall with the door.
Pick up the pan on the ground between the desk and wall.
Carry the pan to stand on the left side of the desk, which is next to a nightstand.
Turn on the lamp at the left back corner of the desk.
anns.task_desc: Carry a pan to turn on a lamp.
